notes.title: The Patch for 'This Land Is My Land' is out. Please update!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings to all our valiant Chiefs and steadfast Warriors of "This Land Is My Land"![/b]

We've heard the whispers and concerns among you, suggesting we might have set sail from the shores of this beloved game in favor of our newer venture, "A Twisted Path to Renown." 
Let us set the record straight: while we are indeed pouring our hearts into developing our new game, our dedication to "This Land Is My Land" remains unwavering. This game holds a special place in our hearts, and we continuously strive to carve out time for its support and enhancement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/464eafe3a16d431ee5feb5ed55643091e6cc8a66.png[/img]

Today marks a significant step in that ongoing journey, as we roll out a Patch aimed at addressing a multitude of existing issues within the game. While this update may not solve every problem just yet, rest assured, our work continues diligently behind the scenes. For a detailed list of what's been fixed, please refer to the Patch Notes provided below.

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
- A quest to defeat Tycoon. Several issues have been fixed (also, be aware that forcing Tycoon to leave and 'accepting the warning message' will end the resistance. So in order to play it afterwards - decline the warning)
- ‘Social Access’ limitation rules adjustment (now there’s a ‘5 sec’ time gap allowed for not getting banned from ‘Socials’)
- Social Invaders issues have been fixed (incl. new players)
- Railway system - a few algorithms have been adjusted.
- Other minor bug fixes

But wait… there’s an Event coming after this Patch)

You may submit your scenery screenshot entries until the 17th of February, after which submissions will close and the week-long voting period will start. The winners will be announced on February 24th.

[h3]Rules:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Only 1 entry per contestant.
[*] The screenshot must be undoctored, no filters or adjustments allowed.
[*] The screenshot must feature landscape/scenery.

notes.title: Full Release Out Now - 30% Off
notes.content:
The winds across the ‘West are changing, as smoke signals are sent far and wide to deliver the message all Warriors have been waiting for:

This Land Is My Land is out now on Steam as a full release, bringing the game out of Early Access!

This anticipated release includes all the game’s prior major updates, together with a large number of fixes in order to polish the game to its fully released state. So, to say thank you for supporting us, enjoy the base game at 30% off, until October 27th!

What a wild three years of development it's been! In this time, we've included the following and much more:

[b]Railroad and Trains[/b]

Our recent train system update enhanced the tension and conflict across the frontier! Used to deliver resources to help settlers re-establish and strengthen their offense to take your land, this system completely changes the mid to late gameplay. But you have the ability to fight back! Throughout its construction, prevent settlers from building sections of the railway by blowing up the train, destroying construction camps, and more.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/j5UmFY7.gif[/img]

[b]Realistic Needs[/b]

Thirst, Hunger, Fatigue, Illness—these basic human needs come into play as you make your way across the frontier. Hunt, source, and craft food to satisfy your hunger and rest near any lit campfire. Protect yourself from and make remedies for a variety of diseases that existed in real-life 19th century America.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/34hAneN.gif[/img]

[b]Realistic Damage[/b]

Heavy bleeding?! Broken limb?! After high demand, realistic damage is available to add another level of realism and danger to your "This Land Is My Land" experience. Every character, including the chief, suffers from combat aftermaths on different body parts and various effects such as shock and infections, where each will require quick action to overcome them or die. We added lungs, heart, and testicles to enemies, and when you hit these parts, they cause extra damage and deal heavy bleeding.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0PLFwGC.gif[/img]

[b]Realistic Nights[/b]

Our toggleable Realistic Nights mode has added another layer of immersion to the game - turned on, it makes nights in-game quite dark and realistic, improving immersion even for the most hardcore player.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/8d30a9f496fbe21e2842d9eb2b2d2e224c6f9892.jpg[/img]

[b]The Ability to Burn Down Enemy Settlements[/b]

Burndown enemy settlements or order your warriors to attack the settlement for you, and allow them to burn it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/73091036a9efa9bc5f7205fc89980bd0552c93e5.jpg[/img]

[b]A reworked SOCIAL tab[/b]

We completely reworked the SOCIAL tab and added Events to add a new level of adventure and exploration, and Leaderboards to increase competition amongst players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/2df941150417cc5972dfe68eb63eca231edc1d22.png[/img]

[b]Customizing your Resistance[/b]

Our Resistance Creation menu gives players the ability to choose the type of resistance you want to lead! Select from the existing presets that range from Classic to Immersive Hardcore Realistic Survival mode, play at your own pace and preference, or check the options under settings and personalize your experience. World Bosses will bring new challenges, experiences, and items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/1a6a4fe78776e151a150249d05f073e29f733a10.png[/img]

[b]World Bosses[/b]

We also introduced world enemy bosses or non-obligatory enemies which appear as a dangerous threat on your journey. They will all pose different challenges and unique opportunities for you. You also have an option to disable this feature when creating new resistance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/a315222ad706f6788a4089b9eb0199991883fe02.jpg[/img]

[b]The Weather System[/b]

A recent addition to the game in which occurs on specific biomes in your region and can greatly impact gameplay.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SgVfltj.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/LiCaPpj.gif[/img]

[b]War Parties[/b]

We gave warriors the ability to create war parties, arm them with your warrior’s finest bows or guns, then have them join you on raids. Command them tactically when conquering a settlement or have them follow your movements for a more precise attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/d4c56e027e48d49b2396f72ab0f94cda9486a814.png[/img]

[b]Over 200 settlements to Discover[/b]

Just when you thought you’d explored it all, think again! Over the course of the game we’ve added more than 200 settlements to the game including new camps, prisons, farms, and other types of settlements from the recent update, each settlement will bring different challenges that you may need to overcome.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/133d338d66537e4b69de625714eab9718420f7d5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/ae4c0adc37f96de13f4eab85d0acfff7646bd660.png[/img]

[b]Horse Bond and Related Features[/b]

Bond with any horse and genuinely have a personal mount instead of using a random one as you go. In addition to this, you’ll have: the ability to sneak on a horse, a Saddlebag to carry items on your horse, an ability to call your horse from a distance, Auto-travel while on a horse, The ability to name a horse which will provide unique stats, and a horse progression which will unlock increased horse speed, weight, and health.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/fb79ea009d50138f1868744c681e12502a6e63a6.png[/img]

[b]Caches with Loot[/b]

Many treasures can be found across the new world for those who are willing to explore them. Caches filled with loot are now more prominent throughout the map, and you can find them by exploring or interrogating enemies. During the interrogation, the enemies will tell you where the loot is buried near the settlement.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CYsvLaC.gif[/img]

[b]Warpaints[/b]

Put on warpaints on your Hair, Head, and Body that give different attributes. You can mix and match or wear a full set for additional bonuses, check the Warpaint Store for more choices including very rare ones, the store items update at a certain time of the day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/620e3a452f3ee5107868003ce7ee8b11b84ac465.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/4e5289a94e8b385840ef49df5dc6fbc815a3b140.png[/img]

[b]Fishing[/b]

Fish for more than 10 different varieties, using bows and other weapons, to catch and create meals that boost your warrior's stats, as well as aid in your fight against enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/a687aba30c03f2102d351a976fdaf1ab84b02e3a.jpg[/img]

[b]First-Person Perspective[/b]

Switch perspective from Third-Person to First-Person in-game to allow better aim when hunting animals or targeting enemy settlers. Use it to add more immersion when playing the game through your character's point of view.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/02fb1e35ecbdef86ab98661d9786cef3fe548a8b.jpg[/img]

[b]Avenging Other Players[/b]

Watch out for in-game announcements, wherein a player from another world got slain by an enemy! If this happens, you’ll then be given the power to avenge their death and get rewards once you’ve successfully eliminated the enemy NPC that killed them.

[b]The addition of an Auction feature to the Social Trading System[/b]

Within the Social Trading System, players can interact with and put up their own items up for auction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/9f81a9167f9d931d143cc7440d082ab21c3de72d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/e1a1d80ae6949f0f51e22241075ea79e14071f8b.png[/img]

[b]Localization: French, German, Chinese, Russian, and Ukrainian[/b]

With the help of our responsive and attentive testers who helped us a lot by fixing our texts, you can now play the game in six different languages: English, French, German, Chinese, Russian, and Ukrainian.

[b]And Much More![/b]
[list]
[*] The addition of female NPCs that nurture and support members of the camp by performing various activities.
[*] The ability for camps to also tame and use horses, alongside your warrior.
[*] The ability to rename and reorder camps.
[*] The addition of a new currency: dimes
[*] New types of Bears, Boars, and Wolves.
[*] The addition of farms that produce Grocery, to feed and level up other groups. Grocery can also be poisoned to strategically kill a camp over time. 
[*] The introduction of the Brewery settlement and the addition of alcoholic drinks. 
[*] The addition of new varieties of mines. 
[*] Upgraded warriors’ commands and controls, allowing players to manage 4 groups of 4 warriors by issuing orders such as attack, follow, and more. 
[*] The ability for players to be able to control their strategic gameplay and planning more precisely, with our strategy map speed control update. Pause, give orders, speed up, and see actions get executed with ease. 
[*] The addition of more vantage and safe points added to help warriors watch from afar and prepare for action.

[*] A Wagon overhaul with the introduction of the prisoner wagon mechanic, the post wagon, auto travel for your warrior’s wagons, and the ability to disassemble wagons in camps.

[*] The improvement of animal AI including their speed, so that they are more realistic to players. 
[*] Improved Visuals, AI Behavior, and Overall Game Performance.
[/list]
This is just a small part of what’s been added to the game since Early Access first began, and we’re not done yet! Well, we aim to continue working on the game post-release, listening to community feedback, and releasing essential updates!

notes.title: A Major Update is HERE: Train, Weather System, New Settlements and more!
notes.content:
The wild wonders of the frontier are being threatened, warriors, as the settlers that live amongst it modernize and adapt. With the arrival of a train, a weather system, over 50 new settlements, and more, such progress will only heighten the possibility of danger throughout your lands. 

We also appreciated all those who took part in the closed testing for this update, as well as the community who suggested further game changes and improvements to us, many of which are listed below.

[b]A Train has arrived![/b]

Prepare for further tension and conflict, warriors, as the train arrives to advance the frontier! It will deliver resources to help settlers re-establish and strengthen their offense to take your land, and will completely change the mid to late gameplay. But you will have the ability to fight back! Throughout its construction, you can prevent settlers from building sections of the railway by blowing up the train, destroying construction camps, and more. But be warned, they will not be in a destroyed state for long! We suggest looking out for newspapers to aid your struggle.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/j5UmFY7.gif[/img]

[b]Weather System[/b]

Immersive gameplay is at the forefront of This Land Is My Land, and now we’ve taken it one step further with the addition of rain and sandstorms.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SgVfltj.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/LiCaPpj.gif[/img]

[b]New Settlements[/b]

Just when you thought you’d explored it all, think again! We’ve added more than 50 settlements to the game including new camps, prisons, farms, and other types of settlements, all of which come with their exciting challenges.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8DJ3l8M.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ohg7atV.png[/img]

[b]Introducing the New SOCIAL![/b]

We’ve completely reworked the SOCIAL tab and added Events and Leaderboards to it as well, to make searching and completing events and monitoring your Leaderboard position that much easier.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PiwVtRM.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/qsZVKnH.png[/img]

[b]Women[/b]

After spending much time in development, as well as listening to our community, we’re delighted to reveal that Female NPCs have been added to our camps! They nurture and support members of the camp by performing various activities, with the scope to give them more active roles in the future!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rucT7k0.png[/img]

[b]Avenging Other Players[/b]

Watch out for in-game announcements, wherein a player from another world got slain by an enemy! If this happens, you’ll then be given the power to avenge their death and get rewards once you’ve successfully eliminated the enemy NPC that killed them.

[b]Bug Fixes and QOL Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Players can now wake up stunned enemies.
[*] Leather is now available to craft under the Craft section.
[*] Call Horse ability improved.
[*] Items now remain at the same location where you died. 
[*] Fixed a bug where settlements could appear in the wrong places.
[*] Fixed a bug with the displacement of the character when riding a horse.
[*] Fixed a bug due to which, when restarting the game and creating a new resistance, the player was offered the same World Seed as before restarting the game.
[*] Added a new anti-cheat system to ensure the online component of the game is fair for all players. If you wish to use cheats and trainers for the single-player part of the game, please be sure not to bring those items to the SOCIAL trading system. Players who do will be caught, and access to the online features will be restricted.
[*] Added new animations.
[*] Improved game performance.

notes.title: Survival Update
notes.content:
The American frontier can be a lawless and wild place, filled with unknown dangers, unexplored territories, and uncontrollable elements.

To enhance the experiences of such threats, we’ve crafted brand new survival features that will challenge the seasoned survivalist in you*. We also read your smoke signals sent to us from across the plains of Discord, Steam, and social media and have used them to implement further game changes and improvements listed below.

 * Please note that all new survival features can be toggled in the new resistance creation window.

[h2][b]Realistic Needs[/b][/h2]
Thirst, Hunger, Fatigue, Illness—these basic human needs will come into play as you make your way across the frontier: Hunt, source, and craft food to satisfy your hunger and rest near any lit campfire. Protect yourself from and make remedies for a variety of diseases that existed in real-life 19th century America.

[url=https://i.imgur.com/34hAneN.gif][img]https://i.imgur.com/34hAneN.gif[/img][/url]

[h2][b]Realistic Damage[/b][/h2]
Heavy bleeding?! Broken limb?! After high demand, Realistic Damage is now available to add another level of realism and danger to your “This Land Is My Land” experience. Every character, including the chief, will suffer from combat aftermaths on different body parts and various effects such as shock and infections, where each will require quick action to overcome them or die. We’ve also added lungs, heart, and testicles to enemies, and when you hit these parts, they will cause extra damage and deal heavy bleeding.

[url=https://i.imgur.com/0PLFwGC.gif][img]https://i.imgur.com/0PLFwGC.gif[/img][/url]

[h2][b]New Treatment System[/b][/h2]
Many exposed and hidden threats lie and wait in the new world; Realistic Damage brings debuffs from enemies' shots, and eating raw meat or drinking dirty water could leave you with Typhoid or Parasites!  Recover from various illnesses, wounds, and injuries with our brand new Treatment System, using bandages, medicines, and more that are available to you all over the frontier. You'll have to fight to live in harmony with the new earth...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/ce99a07eaf1e7d224f3b76713dcd335711da6bed.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Realistic Nights[/b][/h2]
Whether you want to ride across the moon-lit plains or crouch stealthily in the shadows, the new toggleable Realistic Nights mode adds another layer of immersion to the game. Turned on, this will make nights in-game quite dark and realistic, improving immersion for the most hardcore player. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/8d30a9f496fbe21e2842d9eb2b2d2e224c6f9892.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Alcoholic Drinks[/b][/h2]
A new type of settlement was added—Brewery. It produces a different kind of alcoholic drink that can be pretty useful in light of new features and can bring quite impressive side effects. Said effects are only available in the new Realistic Needs and Damage modes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/ec850840da24afbd9b323b7fc4cf925eadf54bda.png[/img]

[h2][b]Caches with Loot[/b][/h2]
Many treasures can be found across the new world for those who are willing to explore them. Caches filled with loot are now more prominent throughout the map, and you can find them by exploring or interrogating enemies. During the interrogation, the enemies will tell you where the loot is buried near the settlement.

[url=https://i.imgur.com/CYsvLaC.gif][img]https://i.imgur.com/CYsvLaC.gif[/img][/url]

[h2][b]New Types of Bears, Wolves, and Boars[/b][/h2]
Bears, wolves, boars, oh my! There are now new types of bears, wolves, and boars to encounter that can be slain and looted for new and exciting items! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/351ce6bcf588770a86659ee248177039a31b0010.png[/img]

[h2][b]Customize Your Resistance[/b][/h2]
You can now choose the type of resistance you want to lead with our brand new Resistance Creation Menu! Select from the existing presets that range from Classic to Immersive Hardcore Realistic Survival mode, play at your own pace and preference, or check the options under settings and personalize your experience. World Bosses will bring new challenges, experiences, and items. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/1a6a4fe78776e151a150249d05f073e29f733a10.png[/img]

[h2][b]And much more! [/b][/h2]
Here are some additional features added to the game that has been asked for by our community:
[list]
[*] The option to choose the size of your game world. 
[*] Varying enemy reaction times from Default, to Fast, to Realistic. 
[*] The option to enable/disable Tutorials and Tips.
[*] The option to enable/disable Fast Travel. 
[*] The ability to save your game/rest while near any lit campfire.
[*] Realistic HUD option which makes the game more immersive.
[*] The option to enable/disable the Detection Indicator. Disabling the detection indicator makes the game more realistic and challenging.
[*] An added world seed setting—so you can create your own unique resistance by entering a set of letters and numbers in the corresponding field. You can share the world seed with your friends and play in similar game worlds.
[*] The crawl under the enemy fort wall feature is back!
[*] New enemy speeches have been added.
[*] The prices of some items in trading posts have been changed.
[*] The weight of all items has been changed to make it more realistic.
[*] Now in the camp's "Orders" section, you can specify the number of warriors who will stay to defend the camp while the rest of the warriors will execute gather/mission orders for that camp.
[*] In hardcore mode, after death, you will see the following statistics: how many days you lasted, number of lands retrieved, number of skill points earned, number of enemies interrogated, how many enemies you intimidated, and kill count.
[*] Now in the tab menu, you can see the effects of recently used food/drinks at the bottom.
[*] You can drink and collect water near the water jugs in Realistic Needs mode if you are in a friendly or neutral camp. You can also drink and collect water near buckets and barrels in many enemy settlements. From rivers, you can drink/collect both clean and dirty water.
[*] Multiple new animations have been added.
[*] Numerous new settlements have been added.
[*] Fixed a bug where the functions of interacting with the world and enemies were not displayed in some players' game worlds.
[*] Many more bug fixes, improvements, and tweaks!
[/list]

[u][h1][b]Sneak Peek at Future Content[/b][/h1][/u]
We’re also delighted to reveal a sneak peek into some of the things we’re working on next! 

[h2][b]Base Building System[/b][/h2]
Many of you have asked us if This Land Is My Land will have a base-building feature; we heard you! In the next major update, you will build your Native American camps using the new base-building system.

[url=https://i.imgur.com/hgQbidV.gif][img]https://i.imgur.com/hgQbidV.gif[/img][/url]

[h2][b]Women In This Land Is My Land[/b][/h2]
Due to popular demand, we are now looking into adding women into the game, though we are yet to decide to what extent; we have taken the community’s input to heart and are swiftly acting on it. There are many aspects to work on for such a feature, from new animations to model designs, so please understand this will take a bit of time until it is ready.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/7f7c804200f6c3ab888a91e7bc3cfa107cfc47d4.png[/img]

[h2][b]Trains And More Related Features[/b][/h2]
We are also adding a train to the game that players can interact and see in their maps. So stay tuned for more information on this exciting update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/ed63c0d0bcb86034e563077b71236deea9de42d5.png[/img]

Lastly, we would like to thank everyone who took part in the closed testing of this update, the players who helped translate the game to different languages, and the community for all the feedback and patience! We worked on this massive update of This Land Is My Land for all of you! We are already excited about the ones to come in the future! 

Want to know more about our latest update or share your feedback with us? Then join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/thislandismyland]Discord [/url]server to say hello to our team and the rest of the community and follow us on [url=https://www.instagram.com/thislandismylandofficial/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/thislandmyland/]Facebook[/url], and [url=https://twitter.com/TLIML_Official]Twitter[/url]. 

Till next time!
This Land Is My Land Team at Game-Labs

notes.title: A Major Update is HERE: Localization, Enemy Bosses, New Weapons, and More!
notes.content:
Good day, Chiefs!

It is an exciting time for us all as we announce a major update we have been working on. This Land Is My Land is a game driven and fueled by passion, and we genuinely appreciate the emotion our community shows when it comes to mechanics and features. You give us the motivation to make this game as polished as possible.

With that said, here are the inclusions of patch 0.0.3.14532 for This Land Is My Land. Be sure to stay on the lookout for more news and future updates!

[h3][b]New Localization: French, German, Chinese, Russian, and Ukrainian
[/b][/h3]
With the help of our responsive and attentive testers who helped us a lot by fixing our texts, you can now play the game in six different languages:  English, French, German, Chinese, Russian, and Ukrainian.

We also have a system that allows any player to help us improve our localization by fixing errors if they are found. To help us improve our localization, you can suggest your own translation by simply copying the .lng file and changing the text to any language you prefer. Also, as always, players can contact us on our Discord server or report issues and help us to fix them through F11 or Discord support tickets.

[h3][b]Improved Visuals, AI Behavior, and Overall Game Performance
[/b][/h3]
Though it is far from being final, we worked on the game's overall performance and improved it for a better game experience. Animations are greatly improved and AI behavior is enhanced for a more natural response from enemies and allies. These kinds of improvements are always on the team's table to polish the basic gameplay, so expect more down the line.

[h3][b]Gameplay and Basic Mechanics Upgrades
[/b][/h3]
We heard you, and we worked on some of the things that you pointed out. 

[list]
[*] First, we removed the Skill Point (SP) cost when you need to get "unstuck" using the menu button. We changed that so that players can get back to the game without any cost during the unfortunate times where you might get stuck in the world.
[*] New search filters are implemented to the craft tab so players can easily find the items they need to be crafted.
[*] Now on the HP bar, you can see the current health, which will be displayed in numbers.
[*] Horse bond level now grows faster, hay bait now gives more health to your horse, and your bonded horse's health regenerates. 
[/list]
[h3][b]Major Game Additions
[/b][/h3]
We added a lot of good stuff in the game that you will enjoy. 

[list]
[*] Many new settlement varieties and activities have been added. 
[*] There are several new weapons available in the world. You can now use Nagashiko Arsenal 1868 Teppo, H.W. Lancaster & Co Model C Rifle, Lee-Shneider Wheel Gun No.2, Vinceta de 42mm Mortar, and 42mm Grenades in the game. 
[*] There are new boss items that have also been added, such as the Pike, which you can obtain from one of the bosses and sell to the traders for an attractive price. 
[*] We also introduced world enemy bosses or non-obligatory enemies which appear in the late game. They will all pose different challenges and unique opportunities for you.
[*] And one more thing, two new items have been added to the Craft section: Campfire and Long-lasting Campfires! These campfires can be used as outposts, that is, now you can craft campfires and place them in a convenient place, except for settlements. You can fast travel from an established campfire to any friendly camp or outpost with a fire lit, and you can also fast travel to any established campfire if you are near a friendly camp or outpost with a fire lit.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/a315222ad706f6788a4089b9eb0199991883fe02.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]General Fixes and Improvements
[/b][/h3]
We are aware that some bugs hinder players from enjoying This Land Is My Land, we are continually working to fix them. 

[list]
[*] We optimized and fixed the random freezes experienced in the game. 
[*] We also fixed the issue of players being unable to kill or eliminate mounted enemies. 
[*] We fixed the "Add Order" issue which caused to have only Options A, B, C in the list of items.
[*] Players can now have an unlimited number of resistances and no longer be limited by a few saved games where you can continue the adventure. This way, you can fully immerse yourself in the rich gameplay of This Land is My Land.
[/list]

[h3][b]More Updates Are Coming!
[/b][/h3]
The items above are just the start, and we plan to provide notable fixes to the game continuously. Expect more things to come that are based on your feedback. We are committed to delivering a game that lets you experience unique gameplay. We genuinely appreciate your support and feedback.

We love hearing from you, so be sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/thislandismyland][b]Discord[/b][/url] server and say hello to our team and fellow Chiefs.

notes.title: The Massive Update is Here!
notes.content:
Chief,

After many hours of hard work from the development team and our exceptional community members' continuous testing contribution, the update you have been waiting for is here! We present to you the most extensive update of This Land Is My Land to date, which we have no doubt will improve your experience in this dynamic and unique world. 

You can now update the game via the Steam client and play the latest version of This Land Is My Land. Here are the major changes you will experience:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/db81ef9b81c26290e4d54172fe1f5fac7de2f6ae.png[/img]

[h3][b]War Parties
[/b][/h3]We have expanded the warrior management system. You can now have a war party where you will lead up to 16 warriors to battle (4 groups of 4 warriors). You can issue orders such as follow, attack, move, and more. In addition to this, you will be able to manage their equipment and generally utilize your warriors more effectively than ever before. Your war party will also level up automatically as they build experience in battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/423596a2cc575cb3bce62302bdb017aefe3353a6.png[/img]

[h3][b]Horse Bond and More
[/b][/h3]
Make a bond with any horse and genuinely have a personal mount. In addition to this, we added:
[list]
[*] The ability to sneak on a horse to get past the enemy
[*] Saddlebag to carry items on your horse and bring some extra loot with you
[*] Capability to call your horse from a distance by whistling
[*] Auto-travel while on a horse for ease of traveling long rides or performing your usual chief management work on the go
[*] The ability to name a horse which will provide unique stats to the horse similarly to your main character
[*] Horse progression which will unlock increased horse speed and health
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/fb79ea009d50138f1868744c681e12502a6e63a6.png[/img]

[h3][b]Firearms Overhaul
[/b][/h3]You can bring your bow, but don't forget your rifle! We have entirely overhauled firearms, and now guns are much more useful and deadly. The firearms will have different distinctions and their unique use. For example, Flintlocks will now have more significant damage and hit power, Winchesters received more ammo in the magazine, etc. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/9e9a34e656881ba9c884a0732964ed1bf4df70d3.png[/img]

[h3][b]New Unity Version and Optimization
[/b][/h3]The Unity game engine received an update to the latest version with lots of technical work behind the scene. In English terms, you shall see increased game stability, better FPS—especially for lower-end computers—and general compatibility. This update also allows us to continue improving other aspects of the game and provides the tools we need to keep building the game furthermore.

We have optimized the game for better performance and stability. With the engine update and more optimization work, you can expect a smoother and better game experience. Please, keep in mind that this is still not final, and we will keep optimizing the game. Optimization is one of the essential focuses in our development stages of This Land Is My Land.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/5703c222bc12dd7a7e0263815cc2656a8a7d6fbe.png[/img]

[h3][b]Improved Character Creation and Naming System Changes
[/b][/h3]One of the most popular feedback we received about This Land Is My Land is the character's creation naming system. We have changed the way things work, and now you will be able to use the name of your choice in combination with additional options. On the most left side of the options are less impactful positive stats with little to no negative impact on your starting stats. While the most right side choices are more impactful stats with higher negative starting stats. Choose wisely because your name is your lineage, and it will bring you immense power or great demise. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/6f14b1250d3aafd36a91667e1e20cd88cd970573.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]New Map Controls & UI Improvements 
[/b][/h3]We have heard your criticism in the progress of the enemy and generally in-game time. To address that, we implemented a speed control for the strategy map. Now you will be able to control your strategic gameplay and planning more precisely. You can pause, give orders, speed up, and see actions get executed.

Various other user interfaces (UI) improvements have also been made for ease of use. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/32b886dc3c78b326108fef7387ace148d7e5327f.png[/img]

[h3][b]New Settlements
[/b][/h3]In the past, we already added a lot of settlement types such as farms, mines, trading locations, etc. We are continually improving and expanding with new settlements to increase the immersion of the game. Now you can enjoy new graphics for the former locations and new types of areas such as the Steam Donkey, different varieties of mines, and other gathering places.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/96a553ca209f8dede8d7f848ed01a57236e2a4f4.png[/img]

[h3][b]SOCIAL inventory change
[/b][/h3]Your SOCIAL inventory will now grow over time when you use the SOCIAL trading feature. For those that do not know, SOCIAL trading is a feature found in the game which allows you to trade with other real players. That is an essential tool to find resources that might not be located nearby your friendly camps or do not want to be bothered to gather them. Warpaint prices are now significantly lower and will only cost tokens and skill points. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/a3e5135db9ddf9c5ed7226af9ef17130f407f8d8.png[/img]

[h3][b]Animal AI
[/b][/h3]We have tweaked and improved some issues with animals. The artificial intelligence (AI) of animals has dramatically improved, so they are now more realistic. Animal speed has also received changes per your feedback and suggestions in addition to our internal testing. Player hunting and fishing are improved, which now provides more resources and makes fishing easier. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/6c87ffeae9bc6e0253ee10ec1556a2c9ea19b1ef.png[/img]

[h3][b]Player Health
[/b][/h3]We increased the player's health so you can live to fight another day! Your health improves furthermore by leveling up your character skills using skill points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/6e9ad89b63e2d2a45e7c1c59d8ab0c523ecf7e04.png[/img]

[h3][b]Animation Improvements
[/b][/h3]All around animation improvements have been made. Lots more to come!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/535e526b623192652446f1fc4d3364470031d63a.png[/img]

[h3][b]Bug fixes
[/b][/h3]We are actively testing the game, reading your in-game reports (press F11 to report bugs), and your discussion posts. From this information, we have fixed lots of bugs, and we will continue to do so. Thank you for all the inputs, reports, and support on the bug fixing process.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/09b41cf9190ee4058ae8751e3079c3c814bf00ff.png[/img]

[h3][b]And More!
[/b][/h3]What is the fun if we spoil it all! Jump in now and try the game for yourself. There are many new changes you will notice that has not been mentioned here, such as the new main menu music you can immediately enjoy before you set out to take back your lands. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/d4c56e027e48d49b2396f72ab0f94cda9486a814.png[/img]

The road for the game does not end here! There is still a lot to come, and we are excited for everyone to jump in and see the changes for yourself. If you have never played the game before, there has never been a better time to try it. 

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1069640/This_Land_Is_My_Land/]Play This Land Is My Land now on Steam![/url]
[/b]

notes.title: Major Update: Patch 0.0.2.10093
notes.content:
[h1]Patch 0.0.2.10093 is now live with farms, wagons and more![/h1]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453459/e3ca09463613907cab8f5d71c7e6b6537682bda5.png[/img]


[*]Farms and Wagons added:

Farms add another layer to the world development. They will produce Grocery—an item which is used by other groups to level up their members. The farm sends wagons full of Grocery to the nearest populated camps over time (but only when the player is far enough). Players can poison the Grocery while they are on the farm or traveling in a wagon. The Poisoned Grocery will kill camp members over time (but, again, only when the player is far enough from said camp). 

As a result, the new farm mechanics work best when you silently enter the farm, take the Grocery there, poison it, return it into the containers, and leave the farm vicinity. Within a few game days, you will notice that some camps are losing their members due to the poison.

[*]Potions re-balances:

We believe the way potions worked before (instant health regeneration) is not a good thing because you could take an enormous number of potions with you, and you can be invulnerable for quite some time. Now, most potions will heal over time, but in combination with other potions (such as max health potions) will provide subtle new combinations. 

[*]AI refactoring:

We have created a new animal AI which works considerably better than before. Human AI was reworked to make it more competitive and challenging. As always, AI improvements will continue.

[*]Animation update:

We have improved numerous things in animations to make them more appealing. Such improvements will increase the immersion and gameplay experience.

[*]Sound update:

We changed the way how the sound engine works, and now it provides better sound positioning and balance.

[*]Another pass on optimization:

We spent some time on optimization, so now, the game takes less memory, and you can expect better framerates. Optimization is still not final, and we will continue to make improvements as development progresses. 

[*]UI improved:

We changed small but essential things here and there to make the game slightly more convenient.

[*]Enemy Camp Names:

We renamed the enemy camps to present them with more fitting names according to the camp type (such as forts, trading posts, etc.).

[*]Bug fix:

We squashed numerous nasty bugs (like losing your horse on save) and introduced new ones so that you will have a good time finding them and as always, report them so we can exterminate them for you in no time!

[*]And many more changes!
[/list]

notes.title: Frequently Asked Questions
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35453459/ab2f5c1eb33a8c589be31026940ca634ab5bd083.png[/img]

[list]
[*][b]What is the game about?[/b]

This Land is My Land is an open-world stealth action game set in the 19th-century American frontier. Players take the role of a Native American chief in the resistance of the onset of the settlers.

[*][b]Who are the developers?[/b]

This Land is My Land is being developed by Game-Labs—a small international indie team. We are most known for the Ultimate General series and age of sail MMO Naval Action.

[*][b]How many people are working on the game?[/b]

A group of four, extremely dedicated developers are working 70+ hours a week.

[*][b]What platforms will the game be available on? Will there be Console release?[/b]

Initially, the game will only be available on Windows. Other platforms (such as Xbox One and PS4) are under consideration. As a small team, working on different fronts at the same time would not be ideal for us. 

[*][b]What distribution method will be used to release the game?[/b]

We plan to use Steam as the main distribution service, at the moment we cannot provide information about other online distribution services or physical copies of the game. 

[*][b]Is the game on steam yet?[/b]

You can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1069640/This_Land_Is_My_Land/]wishlist the game[/url] on steam right now.

[*][b]Is there a release date?[/b]

We plan to move into Early Access stage of This Land is My Land in Autumn 2019. The full release will be the next step after.

[*][b]Approximately how long will this game be in early access?[/b]

The early access stage is expected to last six months to a year. That will allow us enough time to polish the game thoroughly and include all the features we have planned.

[*][b]How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?[/b]

When the game reaches full release, it will include all the planned contents such as trains, carts, numerous settlements and additional quests among other things. It will have fewer bugs and issues because we will be focusing on fixing those during the early access stage. We plan to continue adding more content even after the full release of the game through updates and DLCs.

[*][b]Can I support the development process or access the game now?[/b]

Certainly! At the moment the game is available for purchase in the form of preorders. Some of the packages will give you instant access to the current stage of the game. Please check the [url=https://www.thislandmyland.com/preorder ]preorder page[/url] on our website.

[*][b]Will this game have multiplayer or co-op? Will the game be single-player only?[/b]

The game is Single-Player only. There is no synchronous multiplayer features present, but it will feature an online component which will allow players to interact with each other within the game under the social tab. This is not to be confused with actual co-op gameplay. 

[*][b]Is a persistent online connection required to play the game?[/b]

The game requires an online connection, though even the lowest quality is acceptable. The internet is used during log-in and in-game social features.

[*][b]Is there controller support for the game?[/b]

Yes, the game will have controller support. 

[*][b]What languages will the game support?[/b]

For the time being, the game is only available in English. However, several other language supports will be added later.

[*][b]What engine is the game built on?[/b]

This Land is My Land is being developed using Unity 5.

[*][b]What are the system requirements?[/b] 

[u]Minimal[/u]: 

[b]CPU[/b]: Intel Core i5 2.4Ghz or equivalent
[b]GPU[/b]: Nvidia Geforce GTX 950 or equivalent
[b]RAM[/b]: 8gb
[b]Storage[/b]: 10gb
[b]OS[/b]: Windows 7, 64bit

[u]Recommended[/u]:

[b]CPU[/b]: Intel Core i7 3.2Ghz or equivalent
[b]GPU[/b]: Nvidia Geforce GTX 1070 or equivalent
[b]RAM[/b]: 16gb
[b]Storage[/b]: 10gb
[b]OS[/b]: Windows 10, 64bit

[*][b]Are the materials which have already been posted online taken from in-game or pre-renders/concept art?[/b]

All footage was captured in-game during early development and are actual screenshots.

[*][b]Who created the music on the main trailer video?[/b]

It is created by a good friend of the studio—Dmitriy Saratsky

[*][b]Will you continue to support the game after full release?[/b]

Yes, we plan to keep updating the game and expanding it with more features and contents.

[*][b]Are there any plans for future DLCs?[/b]

We plan to have DLCs for the game that will add additional contents. However, it is too early to talk about what the DLCs will include. 

[*][b]Can I upgrade to a higher package of the game?[/b]

Yes, you can do this at any time by contacting Xsolla for the upgrade. You will only be paying the difference between the two packages.
	[b]Support Email[/b]: support@xsolla.com
	[b]Live Chat[/b]: [url=help.xsolla.com]help.xsolla.com[/url]

[*][b]How long will the founders’ edition be available for sale?[/b]

That is still under discussion. It will undoubtedly be available until the start of early access stage. We are debating if we should keep it available after that or not.

[*][b]Is there a story in the game?[/b]

There are various quests and objectives in addition to random encounters. The central premise is that you are the chief of a small Native American tribe fighting to take back your people's land and lead the tribes in the process. You create your narrative in this dynamic world.

[*][b]Is the game based on historical accuracy?[/b]

This Land Is My Land is not a simulation game. It unfolds at a specific place that represents a time when the Native Americans were cornered in making a tough choice of assimilating with the foreign civilization or perish into history. 

Our goal is to provide you with a Native American experience, unlike any other from a different perspective of the typical frontier game. The enemy will learn, adapt, and adjust their tactics from the actions you make and keep each playthrough dynamic and unique. They will remember and predict player actions and continually pose a threat to taking back your lands. That is the kind of experience we are delivering to you with This Land Is My Land.

[*][b]Why Native Americans?[/b]

At Game Labs, we always try to bring unique perspectives into the games we create. This Land Is My Land, fills the lack of a Native American perspective, allowing you to become a fearless Native American warrior. We understand this is a sensitive topic for many, but we still took on the challenge to create it, and we can reassure you it is not about who was right or evil or promoting stereotypes. We are immersing you in a unique game world. 

[*][b]What tribe does the player represent?[/b]

There are no set specific tribes in the game. 

[*][b]How did you go about writing a story from the perspective of a Native American?[/b]

We always do extensive research on subjects we chose to make sure our games are relevant to the context they cover. That includes the active involvement of the community during development. In terms of the story, This Land Is My Land lets you create your narrative, and find your way in the living, changing world. Due to the nature of the game's systems, each playthrough will unfold differently because the AI will also adapt to the actions and decisions of the player. The geographical landscapes will remain the same, but camps, cities, mines, patrols, animals, hideout, allies, and many gameplay aspects will be different for every player.

[*][b]How big is the map?[/b]

The map is over 100 mile square playable area.

[*][b]Will there be character customization in the game?[/b]

There will be some customization features but not one that will change the looks and sex of the character. 

[*][b]Can we play as a female character?[/b]

There are no plans for female characters at this moment.

[*][b]Will there be more melee weapons? Spears, war hammers, more knives, etc.[/b]

Melee weapons are currently used for stealth kills. We like the idea of switching your primary weapon to kill or stun by using knives, tomahawks, or clubs. However, this is not in the works yet and will remain under consideration.

[*][b]Will there be body armor?[/b]

No, we do not have plans for body armors. 

[*][b]Will there be enemy tribes?[/b]

We have not decided on this yet. Currently, all the tribes are friendly.

[*][b]Can warriors ride horses?[/b]    

Yes, we will implement this feature.

[*][b]Will there be player-to-player trading?[/b]

Yes, this feature will be available as part of the social tab.

[*][b]How does the Karma system work?[/b]
You start with neutral karma (grey), and it is directly co-related with your actions and playstyle. Both positive (blue) and negative (red) karma have unique benefits of their own. You can play as you like.

[*][b]Is there a button for taking all items in the game inventory system?[/b]
Yes, hold shift and press left click on the item’s “take” button.

[*][b]Can I participate in voice acting for the game?[/b]
Yes, you can! Check our voice acting channel on our official Discord server for more information.

[*][b]How do I report a bug?[/b]

You can report a bug by pressing F11 in the game and filling out the information. 

[*][b]How do I take screenshots in the game?[/b]

Press F12 to take high-quality screenshots with the built-in system. Depending on your system specs, it might take a few seconds to generate the screenshot.

[*][b]Where does the skill points under the social tab come from?[/b]

It is generated from the player actions, and it can be redeemed across all your resistances (game saves/profiles).

[*][b]How do I add the founders’ edition bonus of adding a name to the enemies roster? How does this feature work?[/b]

You can add a name to the enemy roaster under the social tab. You can also track how well the character is doing in the whole game universe. The character you created will also appear in other player’s worlds. 

[*][b]How do I get the unique bow as founder package owner?[/b]

You can collect it every 2 hours under the social tab in-game.

[*][b]How often do you release updates?[/b]

That can vary, but we release updates very regularly. Usually, once a week at least, but it all depends on the complexity of the patch, among other things. 

[*][b]Will there be game progress wipes?[/b]

Most likely not. So far, we have had none, and we strive to keep it that way unless development of the game forces it due to technical reasons. 

[*][b]What is the best way to communicate with the developers and the rest of the community?[/b]

You can communicate with us and our fans via our official Discord server, social media, and forums. Discord would be the best way.

[*][b]Will there be a wiki for the game?[/b]	

Yes, there will be an official game wiki.

[*][b]Do you have a public roadmap for the development of the game?[/b]

Yes, we do! Check the #roadmap channel on our official Discord server for the latest information on this.

[*][b]I have payment/transaction issues; what should I do?[/b]

Please, contact Xsolla support, and they will resolve the issue with you. 
	[b]Support Email[/b]: support@xsolla.com
	[b]Live Chat[/b]: [url=help.xsolla.com]help.xsolla.com[/url]
If you do not find a solution with Xsolla, email us at info@thislandmyland.com. We will make sure to fix it. Sorry for the inconvenience this might have caused you. 

[*][b]I have technical issues; what should I do?[/b]

Try standard technical solutions first such as running the game as admin, restarting PC, reinstallation of the game, add an exception of the game under your anti-virus and firewall, checking for driver and windows updates, etc. If nothing works, create a ticket under our Discord #support channel. We will assist you!

[*][b]Any tutorials and uncut gameplay videos you recommend?[/b]

One of our fans is known within the community to create regular tutorials with actual gameplays on his Youtube channel. You cannot go wrong with the contents he provides. Check out his videos by clicking [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCB_TbzsjZCZbfpNGa3e-q4w/videos ]here[/url]. 

[*][b]What is the business contact email for This Land Is My Land?[/b]

You can contact us via email at info@thislandmyland.com 
(Note that there is no “is” in the email address. Same as our website URL)

[*][b]What are your social media and forum available at this moment?[/b]
